uses.finding: The BSB incunable's printed colophon reads M.CCCC. lxxxxi under Pope Innocent; the red 1496 is an added entry, so the stage is dated 1491. The postconciliar Spanish-proper candidate is retitled as the Spanish version of the Latin proper confirmed 15 April 1975.

uses.finding: The 1550→1604 Suscepimus edge duplicated the 1550→1553→1603→1604 chain and was removed (no stage deleted). CD 98/69 of 2 June 1969 read in Notitiae 5 (1969) pp. 359–360; the 1971 chapter confirmation and Dirks's commentary read in Notitiae 8 (1972) pp. 14, 17–18; the 1985 Proprium Missale et Lectionarium is a new documented stage from its title, mandate, decrees and promulgation letter.

uses.finding: The joint 8 June 1971 reply to OCist and OCSO is recorded once (ocso-next:ordo-particularities-1971) and now mapped on the Cistercian route and tradition note; the OCist Latin supplement of 11 March 1980 (CD 375/80) is recorded on the 1983 book stage.

uses.finding: The OCR text layers of every Notitiae issue 1965–1995 were searched (bounded; OCR misses possible): no general OCSO Latin proper approval after CD 83/75 (1975) was found; the 1983 entries found concern Blessed Maria Gabriella, including the Latin collect of CD 124/83 (already staged), calendar grants and vernacular versions. Confirmations of French (1976), Spanish, Dutch and English (1979–1980) and Irish (1981) versions date the order's requests for vernacular versions by language region, not use of the Latin texts; 1980 house-level grant at four Italian monasteries; 2011 Latin collect and memorial for Blessed John Paul II.
uses.limit: Signed instruments and the Rome 1983 book still unseen; no named house's use of an exact Latin book; no medieval OCSO identity assigned.
uses.next_sources: DLI 83442; order archive; Notitiae 1996–2011 beyond index issues.

uses.finding: An undated incunable (BSB bsb00030081; BSB-Ink [1496], GW not after 1496) is a provisional stage (downgraded from documented by the cold review because its year is a catalogue attribution); it prints the same oblation prayer, with word-order variants, and the same Gloria reading as Pavia 1561; the 1561 rubricated offertory section is not in its pre-Canon block.
uses.limit: Year is a catalogue attribution; only the pre-Canon block read; no Carthusian missal confirmation in Notitiae 1965–1995.
uses.next_sources: Kerver and Lyon printings; complementary Ordinarium; 1677 ordinance.

uses.finding: The 1622 missal (BSB bsb10869683) title and embolism rubric were read; the older paten ceremonial of the copies catalogued 1530 and 1578 has given way by 1622 to the rubric King (p. 177) associates with the Pian Ordinary (new documented transition); the existing 1739 edge now starts from 1622.
uses.limit: 1663 missal and 1739 ordinal not found online; 1530 copy's own date unverified.

uses.finding: Notitiae dates the Canons Regular Confederation's Latin Mass proper (1974; Rome 1974 printing listed) and the Windesheim-Victorine Congregation's calendar (1974) and Latin Proprium Missarum (1976).
uses.limit: Books uninspected; no medieval continuity asserted.

independent_review.reviewer: independent batch-5 cold reviewer, distinct from the lane author and the coordinator
independent_review.scope: Reviewed lane commit 8ec97d9a3 against base a17f42c7e. The reviewer fetched into its own scratch, and looked at, the BSB page images for every added or changed stage and transition: OSA 1491 colophon canvas 565; Carthusian incunable canvases 230-236 and 558-571; Pavia 1561 canvases 254-256; Premonstratensian copies catalogued 1530 (276-277) and 1578 (314); 1622 title and p. 269. It also read the GW and BSB-Ink records, the op.org 1985 Dominican Proprium (PDF 1-17 and 48-53), and 29 Notitiae issues covering every cited page: Dominican 1969 and 1972; OCSO 1976-1983 and 2012; Canons Regular 1975-1976; OSA 1972 and 1975; and every item the lane had read only in OCR (1972, 1973, 1974, 1977, 1978, 1979), plus unmarked Teutonic, Pauline and OCSO 1965-1967 items. King pp. 176-177 and 217-218 and Bonniwell pp. 320-321 were read from hash-recorded earlier-batch copies. Ownership, text-field, route-row and hygiene checks were also run. Corrections: the Carthusian 1496 stage and its witness-succession edge became provisional (catalogue-only year; GW 'not after 1496'; no encoded difference from 1561); a wrong shelfmark and a wrong register locus were fixed; the oblation 'agreement' was narrowed to word-order variants; the 1985 Dominican promulgation was re-dated to Couesnongle's letter of 15 August 1983, distinct from the 3 April 1985 printing mandate and the 1985 publication; OCSO negative findings were rephrased as a bounded OCR search naming the 1983 Latin collect (CD 124/83); vernacular confirmations were narrowed from 'reception' to permissions; the Premonstratensian 'Pian' label was attributed to King p. 177; unmarked OCR-derived items were qualified and two were re-described; the receipt counts and title were corrected. Not checked: whole-book or body collations; the 1570 Roman Missal against the 1622 rubric; ISTC (bot check); re-probes of access refusals and negative catalogue searches beyond plausibility. No stage, transition or candidate was added. The routing classification in catholic-eucharistic-history-v1.toml that still names the removed Dominican transition is left to the coordinator.
